name_reason: Prefix crt_equivalent_ is correct (FD2-customized CRT-equivalent LX loader helper, not a vendor byte-match). The _36344 suffix is Ghidra address residue: it equals the function's own entry address 0x36344 (same class as the _52758 residue called out in the rules). The descriptor lx_header_reader is unique in the CRT pool, so stripping the address suffix is safe and required. Descriptor accurately reflects the body: it reads/introspects the MZ->LX header and object table.
purpose: LX/LE executable header introspection: validate MZ->LX wiring and compute an FD2-specific image-size aggregate (num_objects*15 + sum of object virtual sizes) used by the LX module loader to size its output buffer.
logic_summary: Pre-fills a 4-byte magic slot with 0x00002020 (loaded from the relocated immediate at 0x360ff). Resolves a handle: if mode_byte&1==0 it open()s path with oflag 0x200 (returns 0 on -1); if mode_byte&1==1 it reuses arg0 directly as an in-memory base address. Reads 4-byte e_lfanew at MZ+0x3C (no MZ-magic check), reads the 2-byte LX magic at e_lfanew into the slot, and strcmp()s the slot against "LX" (data at 0x502f0). On magic mismatch it calls close(handle) UNCONDITIONALLY (ignores mode bit0) and returns 0. On match it re-reads the full 0xAC LX header into a stack buffer, computes obj_tbl_off = e_lfanew + lx_header[+0x40] (object_table_offset) and num_objects = lx_header[+0x44], then loops num_objects times reading each 0x18-byte object record (chaining obj_tbl_off through the chunk reader's returned end position) and accumulates record[+0x00] (object virtual size). It close()s the handle only when mode bit0 is clear, and returns num_objects*15 + accumulated virtual size (SHL 4 / SUB pattern = *15). All file/memory access is delegated to crt_equivalent_lx_chunk_read_36107, which selects lseek+read vs memcpy based on the same mode bit0.

params.name: path
params.semantics: Overloaded by mode_byte bit0. When bit0==0 it is a null-terminated path string that is open()ed. When bit0==1 it is an int reused as an in-memory base address (every chunk read becomes memcpy from base+offset; open/close skipped). Forwarded to the chunk reader as the file_handle/base argument.
params.reason: The name path only covers the bit0-clear case. In bit0-set mode arg0 is an in-memory base address (see callee memcpy(dest, offset+file_handle, length)), not a path. path_or_base captures both roles without an address suffix.

params.name: mode_byte
params.semantics: Mode/store-selector. bit0: 0 => file-backed (open path, lseek+read, close at end); 1 => in-memory (arg0 is a base address, memcpy, skip open/close). Forwarded verbatim to every crt_equivalent_lx_chunk_read_36107 call so the same backing store is used for each read.
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate; no address residue. Captures the mode/flag nature of the byte.

returns.semantics: FD2-specific image-size aggregate = num_objects*15 + sum(object virtual_size) on a valid LX module; 0 on open failure (-1) or LX magic mismatch. Not a standard loader-API value; consumed by crt_equivalent_lx_module_loader_3647b as the total_size for buffer allocation/memset.

reads_globals: 0x360ff (relocated immediate 0x00002020 used to pre-fill the LX magic slot)

issues.title: Unconditional close(handle) on LX magic mismatch ignores mode bit0
issues.description: On LX magic mismatch the function calls close(handle) without testing mode_byte&1. When called in in-memory mode (bit0==1), arg0 is a base address rather than a real file descriptor, so close() is invoked on a non-handle value. This is faithfully reproduced from the original binary (disassembly 0x363ea: PUSH EBP; CALL close at 0x3d01c is unconditional) and MUST NOT be changed -- the CRT-equivalent logic is verified to match FD2.LE. Recorded for awareness only. Practically unreachable: the sole (itself-dead) caller crt_equivalent_lx_module_loader_3647b only loads a valid LE image. The success-path close() at the end is correctly gated by bit0; only the mismatch error path is not.
issues.evidence: disassemble_function 0x00036344: at 0x363e8 JZ skips to 0x363f5 (match path); fall-through 0x363ea PUSH EBP / 0x363eb CALL 0x0003d01c (close) then JMP 0x3638a (return 0), with no TEST of [ESP+0xe0]&1 guarding it -- contrast the success-path close at 0x36451 TEST byte ptr [ESP+0xe0],0x1 / JNZ 0x36464.

notes: Source comment in crt.c (lines 58-94) is already precise, ASCII-clean, and consistent with the binary (overloaded arg0, 0x2020 pre-fill, strcmp vs LX, object-table loop, num_obj*15+sum return formula, unconditional-close note). No Edit to crt.c was needed (comment_verdict=keep), so crt.c is not in the staged set. Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with the refined understanding -> ghidra_plate_action=none. Verified pre-fill value 0x00002020 by reading memory at 0x360ff (bytes 20 20 00 00) and strcmp target by reading 0x502f0 (bytes 4c 58 00 00 = "LX"). Return *15 confirmed via SHL EAX,0x4 / SUB EAX,EDX at 0x3646a-0x3646d. __cdecl confirmed: plain RET at 0x3647a, sole caller cleans 2 args (ADD ESP,0x8). Name/param renames recorded only; to be applied in Stage 2 (touches protos.h + the single call site at 0x364cc in crt_equivalent_lx_module_loader_3647b).
